result.title: CrossPressor: Scalable Cross-View Fusion for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) becomes increasingly difficult to scale to long multi-view sequences. Anchor-based compression methods such as ZPressor alleviate representation growth by decoding Gaussians only from a compact set of anchor feature maps, but keeping these anchors fixed forces each one to aggregate an increasing number of support views. We identify this representation--fusion mismatch and introduce \textbf{CrossPressor}, a training-free method for scalable anchor-based fusion. CrossPressor preserves all decoder-facing anchor queries while constraining the view-growing support sequence through coverage-cycled evidence routing, distributing retained spatial evidence across support views and fusion layers while keeping all support views represented. Routing before K/V projection, together with joint context packing, further reduces support-side fusion cost without retraining. CrossPressor maintains reconstruction quality close to dense fusion while achieving up to $26.12\times$ faster cross-view fusion and $1.43\times$ end-to-end acceleration on long input sequences. Our project page is at: https://yuhsihu.github.io/CrossPressor.

AI.brief_summary: 针对前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 在长多视角序列中锚点固定、单个锚点需聚合越来越多视角的「表示—融合失配」，提出免训练的 CrossPressor，用覆盖轮转的证据路由把保留的空间证据分散到各支持视角与融合层，并降低融合开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其固定容量瓶颈下强约束「所有支持视角都被表示」的证据路由思路，可能为 LVR 在有限 latent 预算内筛选视觉证据、避免单一视角主导与信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；但任务属 3D 重建，迁移价值需人工判断。
